visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair, red lipstick, wearing a white t-shirt and a black blazer, is holding a phone for a selfie video in a brightly lit retail environment. Behind her, a young girl with long dark hair, wearing a light green cardigan over a graphic white tee and a plaid skirt, is examining rows of small cosmetic bottles displayed on tiered wooden shelves. (2) The girl turns to face the camera, smiling brightly with a youthful expression. The setting is filled with warm, soft indoor lighting, highlighting the organized display of various beauty products and promotional posters in the background. (3) The camera focuses on the girl's hands as she holds up two small bottles of nail polish with white caps. This is followed by a close-up of a hand with pinkish glittery manicured nails, demonstrating the application of the product. The background shifts to include colorful nail art sample cards. (4) The visuals transition to graphic slides showcasing different nail polish styles: 'full cover', 'layered', and 'dotted'. The graphics use soft pastel tones and clear, simple layouts to highlight the product's versatility. (5) Returning to the store setting, the girl is seen holding the two bottles close to her face, smiling warmly at the camera. The surrounding shelves remain well-stocked with similar small bottles, maintaining the retail context.
